content: {"like":["Prefers high‑quality, immersive audio with clear dialogue and deep bass","Values vivid, natural color grading and sharp detail in visuals","Enjoys well‑executed CGI that feels realistic and integrated","Appreciates thoughtful extras like making‑of documentaries and commentary","Favors atmospheric sound design with subtle foley and ambient effects"],"dislike":["Dislikes CGI that looks unrealistic or overly smoothed","Avoids muted colors, pasty skin tones, and low contrast scenes","Rejects ads or previews that reduce film space and increase compression","Prefers no soft focus or excessive smoothing of details","Dislikes lack of directional audio or limited surround usage"]}
